system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> continuing problem. Someone got into my account & is using it. They also changed my account to a family plan. I’ve changed my FB password. What else can I do? <USER> <USER>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating. Can you send us your account's email address or username via DM? We'll help you sort this out! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Requesting sensitive info via DM is good, but add security advice and remove '/AI' tag."}
